chapter.verse: Tua ciangin tuipi pan sapi khat hong dingto ka mu hi. Sapi in sakia sawm leh lutang sagih nei a, tua sakite tungah kumpi-dialkhip sawm omin a lutangte tungah daisakna minte om hi.

Sapi ka muh pen kamkei tawh kibang a, a khete vom khe tawh kibangin a kam pen humpi kam tawh kibang hi. Gulpi samnei in tua sapi' tungah ama' vangliatna, ama' kumpi-tokhom leh uktheihna thu a lianpi pia hi.
A lutangte khat in sih nading khop liamma a nei dan hinapi, tua liamma dam khinin leitung bup in lamdangsakna tawh tua sapi zui uh hi.

Tua ciangin amaute in gulpi samnei bia uh hi. A hang pen gulpi samnei in ama' uktheihna thu sapi' tungah na pia khin ahih man hi. Amaute in sapi bia uh a, “Sapi tawh a kibang kua omin kua in amah lehdo zo ahi hiam?” ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin thu lianpipi genin zahpihna kam a pau muk khat, sapi' tungah kipia a, tua banah kha sawmli-le-nih sung ukna thu zat theih nading phalna kipia hi.
Tua ciangin sapi in a kam ka-in Pasian daisakna kam pau a, Pasian' min leh ama' tenna phual, lam khatin vantunga a teengte, zahpih hi.
Tua banah amah pen mi siangthote a do dingin leh a zo dingin zong phalna kipia hi. Minam, tualmi, kampau, khualmi a namkimtebuktheih nading thu zong kipia lai hi.
Tua ciangin leitunga a teengte khempeuh—a kigolum Tuuno ii nuntakna laibu sungah leitung kilamkip ma-in a min uh a kigelh lo khempeuh—in amah bia uh hi.
Bil nei a om leh hih thu za ta hen:

Mi khatpeuh galmat samat a tuak ding ahihleh galmat samat mah tuak pah a, mi khatpeuh namsau tawh thah a tuak ding ahihleh namsau tawh thahna tuak pelmawh ding hi. Hih thu ah mi siangthote in thuakzawhna leh a upna a neih ding uh kisam hi.
Tua ciangin sapi dang khat leitung pan hong dingto ka mu hi. Sapi in tuuno bangin saki nih nei a, gulpi samnei bangin kam pau hi.
Tua sapi in sapi khatna ii uktheihna thu khempeuh a mai mah ah zang a, sih nading khop liamma nei-a a dam khin sapi khatna a bia dingin leitung leh a tunga teengte khempeuh thupia hi.
Kihilna lim a lianpite bawlin mei nangawn mite' muhin vantung pan leitung ah kiasak hi.

Amah in sapi' uktheihna thu tawh phalna ngah-a a bawl kihilna limte' tungtawnin leitunga teengte khem a, namsau liamma nei napi a hinglai veve ahi sapi' ading milim khat a bawl nadingun amaute' kiangah gen hi.
Amah in sapi milim tungah husanna piak theih ding phalna ngah a, tua pen sapi milim hong pau theih nading leh sapi milim a bia lote gawhlup a tuahsak theih nading ahi hi.
Tua banah mineu leh milian, mihau leh mizawng, tualmi suakta leh sila, mi khempeuh a taklam khut tung uhah ahihkeileh a tal tung uhah ciapteh dingin bawl hi.
Tua pen sapi min hitaleh ama' min nambat hitaleh, ciaptehna a neilo peuhpeuh in vanlena lei theilo ding, zuak theilo ding, cihna ahi hi.
Hih mun ah pilna kisam hi: ngaihsut pilna a neite in sapi nambat sehgawm ta hen. Hih pen mi khat ii nambat hi a, ama' nambat pen zaguk sawmguk-le-gukc ahi hi.
